    "slack_setpoint": slack_voltage_target,
    "slack_voltage": slack_voltage,
    "selected_line_ids": selected_line_ids,
    "selected_line_metrics": selected_line_metrics
}
print(f"RESULT_JSON={RESULT_JSON}")
